## Palantir Valuation Flagged as Stretched Despite Record Earnings

For a PM long PLTR, the core tension is whether execution strength justifies the multiple — stretched-valuation coverage post-record results suggests any guidance miss or deceleration could drive outsized de-rating relative to peers at lower multiples.

- Palantir reported what coverage characterizes as record earnings, yet the stock is described as looking stretched on valuation.
- The disconnect between strong execution and elevated multiple signals the bar for future upside is high.
- No specific earnings figures, EPS, or revenue are cited in the headline.
- Bearish valuation risk framing despite a constructive underlying fundamental print.
